issues.definition: Dislike, 'bad/useless app', or leaving, with no specific product problem.
issues.name: General App Dislike
issues.summary: Reviewers call the app bad, disappointing, or trash, and one objects to Spotify asking for donations.

issues.definition: Ads too frequent, long, loud, repetitive, or interrupting listening.
issues.name: Frequent and Disruptive Ads
issues.summary: Reviewers report that ads are too loud or frequent, play instead of songs, and interrupt listening between songs.

issues.definition: Free users cannot choose, play or skip the songs they want, or have a skip limit.
issues.name: Free Song Choice Limits
issues.summary: Reviewers say free users cannot pick a specific song, must go through a playlist, or can skip only a limited number of songs.

issues.definition: Seek/rewind, repeat, shuffle-off, queue or order controls locked behind Premium.
issues.name: Premium-Locked Playback Controls
issues.summary: Reviewers report being unable to repeat or play a specific part, choose or skip tracks, use the queue, or play music randomly without restrictions or Premium.

issues.definition: Generally says the app or basic features now require Premium, without naming one control.
issues.name: Basic Features Behind Premium
issues.summary: Reviewers say the app or its basic features are useless without Premium or have been made premium.

issues.definition: The app will not open or load, freezes, lags or crashes.
issues.name: App Crashes or Won’t Load
issues.summary: Reviewers report that the app crashes and will not open, or gets stuck on the loading screen.

issues.definition: Music will not begin or resume, or a connection/offline error prevents playback.
issues.name: Playback Won’t Start
issues.summary: Reviewers report being unable to connect to the internet over Wi‑Fi or having Spotify say it is playing without starting the songs.

issues.definition: Lyrics missing, not loading, locked or incorrect.
issues.name: Lyrics Missing or Not Showing
issues.summary: Reviewers report that lyrics are missing from some songs or sometimes do not show.

issues.definition: Blames an update for making the app worse without naming a specific functional failure.
issues.name: Update Made App Worse
issues.summary: Reviewers say a recent update disappointed them or made the app worse, without identifying a specific functional failure.

issues.definition: A song, artist, album or podcast is absent, removed or unavailable.
issues.name: Missing Music Catalog Content
issues.summary: Reviewers say gospel music is limited and many songs are not available.

issues.definition: Recommendations, DJ or suggested tracks are poor, repetitive or unwanted.
issues.name: Poor or Unwanted Recommendations
issues.summary: Reviewers say recommendations have worsened or ask for them to stop.

issues.definition: Cannot sign in or access the account, with no more specific cause stated.
issues.name: General Account Access
issues.summary: The reviewer says they cannot get into their account and also mentions too many ads.

issues.definition: Password rejected or forgotten, password reset or account recovery fails.
issues.name: Password Rejected
issues.summary: A reviewer says the app will not accept their password.

issues.definition: Downloaded content cannot be found or played offline.
issues.name: Downloaded Content Unavailable Offline
issues.summary: The reviewer reports that offline playback is not working.

issues.definition: Downloads will not start, finish or are not offered.
issues.name: Downloads Stuck
issues.summary: A reviewer reports that songs get stuck while downloading in the background.

membership_rule: issue_id = frozen subtopic from taxonomy/subtopics_v1.json (code); names/summaries are model suggestions; membership is never changed by the model
